text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Haaan...♪ I can't get 
Tachyon-san's\n'Happy birthday' out of my 
head...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(To think she told me the very second the 
date changed...!\nJust remembering it will 
keep me grinning for a whole week!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...What's with you, still all excited? I 
only congratulated you out of courtesy as 
your roommate."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're like this already, I wonder what 
will happen once I give you the 
present...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guh! N-No way...!? Your kind words alone 
would have been more than enough~~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! To get so hyped up over a mere 
trivial expectation... That level of 
energy efficiency... Is truly fascinating, 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Digital-kun! Shall we run an 
experiment to see how much your mind and 
body can change purely from anticipation?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What...!? An e-e-experiment? You're 
saying I get to take part in Tachyon-san's 
experiment!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to my present with bated 
breath. I'll be coming to measure your 
physical data every 30 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We can meet that often!? Eeeeek! That's 
way too much fan service~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~~!! Can a birthday really be this 
blissful~~~~!?
